systems.country_label: WAPIS, installed in a national Data Collection and Registration Centre (DACORE)
systems.owner: Funded by the European Union and implemented by INTERPOL with ECOWAS; Niger's interior minister spoke at the Niamey launch
systems.tiers: Launched in Niger by September 2015 within a national DACORE; collects, centralises and shares police information from national law enforcement agencies, with paper police data to be converted and inserted; each DACORE to be connected to INTERPOL's I-24/7; a regional sharing platform is a later phase
